sentences.text: With partners in the telecommunications sector, these basic smart devices could be made available at a nominal rate to all senior citizens above 60, and those seniors facing financial difficulties could even get these devices for free.

sections.label: Seniors as caregivers
sections.summary: States that during house visits, more seniors were seen as primary caregivers to spouses or adult children with special needs.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: In my house visits, I have come across more and more seniors who are primary caregivers to their spouse or to their adult children with special needs.

sections.label: Caregiving strains seniors' finances
sections.summary: Says many seniors like Mdm Musliah face strained finances as they use savings or retirement funds for caregiving.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: Many of these seniors like Mdm Musliah also face strained financial resources as they dip into their savings or utilise funds supposedly meant for their retirement in the caregiving process.

sections.label: Merdeka Package and outreach manpower
sections.summary: Hopes Merdeka Package incentives encourage early treatment like the Pioneer Generation Package, and questions whether manpower suffices for outreach.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: In the upcoming Merdeka Package, I hope that incentives will be like the Pioneer Generation (PG) Package and encourage our seniors to seek treatment early.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: After the PG Package was introduced, we saw fewer of such cases, as the seniors did not want to lose out on the subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: I am sure the Silver Generation Office will do good outreach to our Merdeka Generation, but I am concerned if there is sufficient manpower to reach out to such a large group of both the Pioneer and Merdeka Generations.

sections.label: CPF rates for older Singaporeans
sections.summary: Urges MOM to consider raising CPF contribution rates for Singaporeans aged 55 and above.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: For one, I would urge MOM to consider raising the CPF contribution rates for Singaporeans aged 55 and above.

sections.label: Raising retirement age to 65
sections.summary: The speaker urges the Government to increase the retirement age to 65 years old.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Second, I would urge the Government to increase the retirement age to 65 years old.

sections.label: Caregiver Training Grant and IDAPE subsidies
sections.summary: The CTG gives up to $200 per eligible care recipient per FY, and IDAPE gives $150 or $250 monthly per eligible caregiver of an elderly Singaporean.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: At the moment, the Caregiver Training Grant (CTG) provides subsidies of up to $200 per eligible care recipient per financial year (FY) for the caregiver.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In addition, IDAPE provides either $150 or $250 a month for each eligible caregiver of an elderly Singaporean, to cover medical bills or nursing costs, or to hire a foreign domestic helper to assist in caregiving.

sections.label: Enticing younger Singaporeans into gerontology careers
sections.summary: The speaker urges reviewing how more younger Singaporeans can be enticed into gerontology and geriatrics careers, with remuneration, progression, recognition, and conversion and training programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In addition, I would urge the Government to review how more among younger Singaporeans can be enticed to pursue careers in both gerontology and geriatrics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: We would need more caregivers for the elderly, more geriatrics-related rehabilitative and occupational therapy professionals, and more gerontology experts to help inform and curate public policies related to the elderly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Plans for more attractive remuneration, career progression pathways and better recognition for those who choose to have their careers in gerontology or geriatrics, need to be put in place.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: For a start, professional conversion programmes (PCPs) and training programmes for mid-career entrants into the gerontology, geriatrics or elderly caregiving sectors can be implemented.

sections.label: Ageing population and old-age support ratio
sections.summary: By 2030 one in four residents will be aged 65 and above, and the old-age support ratio will fall from 4.8 in 2018 to an expected 2.7 in 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: By 2030, one in four residents will be aged 65 and above, close to where Japan is today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: As a consequence, our old-age support ratio will also decrease, from 4.8 in 2018 to an expected 2.7 in 2030.

sections.label: Beneficiaries of subsidised home and community care
sections.summary: As of late 2018, around 16,000 clients benefited from subsidised home and community care services, up from around 14,000 seniors in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: As of late 2018, around 16,000 clients have benefited from subsidised home and community care services, an increase from around 14,000 seniors in 2017.

sections.label: Reviewing CHAS eligibility criteria
sections.summary: MOH agrees with Ms Rahayu Mahzam and is reviewing and updating the per capita household income criteria for CHAS so more Singaporeans can benefit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Ms Rahayu Mahzam has suggested updating the CHAS eligibility criteria.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We agree, and MOH is already in the process of reviewing and, where necessary, updating the per capita household income criteria for CHAS, so that more Singaporeans can benefit from CHAS subsidies.

sections.label: Caregiver Support Action Plan
sections.summary: MOH and partner agencies developed a Caregiver Support Action Plan to strengthen support for caregiving, drawing on feedback from the caregiving ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We need to help them on this journey.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Therefore, drawing on feedback from the caregiving ecosystem and the people operating within the system, MOH, together with partner agencies, have developed a Caregiver Support Action Plan to strengthen support for caregiving.

sections.label: More AICare Link touchpoints
sections.summary: AIC will create four more AICare Link touchpoints and embed them at Silver Generation Office satellite offices by the second half of 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: AIC will create four more AICare Link touchpoints and also embed them in the community at Silver Generation Office satellite offices by the second half of 2019.

sections.label: New Home Caregiving Grant
sections.summary: A new Home Caregiving Grant will be introduced by the end of 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On that score, I am pleased to announce that we will introduce a new Home Caregiving Grant (HCG) by end of 2019.

sections.label: Grant replaces FDW Grant
sections.summary: The grant will replace the FDW Grant, with an enhanced quantum of $200 per month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The grant will replace the FDW Grant, with an enhanced quantum of $200 per month.

sections.label: HCG replaces FDW Grant
sections.summary: The HCG of $200 per month will replace the FDW Grant, an increase from $120 per month, and allow caregivers greater flexibility on use.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: It is, therefore, limited because not all caregivers might need or want an FDW.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: So, we will replace this with the HCG of $200 per month, which is an increase on the present $120 per month for the FDW Grant, and also allow caregivers greater flexibility on how they choose to use this sum.

sections.label: MediSave for siblings' healthcare
sections.summary: Caregivers may use their MediSave to help pay for the healthcare expenses of their Singaporean siblings by the end of 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On that score, we agree that family caregivers, first of all, they are usually the first port of call, and fundamentally in the entire ecosystem, they are key to supporting our seniors age-in-place.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: So, we will allow caregivers to use their MediSave to help pay for the healthcare expenses of their Singaporean siblings by the end of 2019.

sections.label: Respite services client numbers
sections.summary: Over 2,400 clients have benefited from respite services in senior care centres and nursing homes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: To date, over 2,400 clients have benefited from respite services in senior care centres and nursing homes.

sections.label: Night respite for dementia seniors
sections.summary: AIC will pilot a new night respite service for seniors with dementia who may have sleep and behavioural issues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: To support such caregivers, AIC will pilot a new night respite service for seniors with dementia who may have sleep and behavioural issues.

sections.label: Pre-enrolment system pilot
sections.summary: AIC will pilot a pre-enrolment system this year to reduce time needed to activate respite services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Dr Chia Shi-Lu suggested allowing families to pre-register essential information with providers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We have been studying this idea and will pilot a pre-enrolment system this year to further reduce the time required to activate respite services.

sections.label: Provider trial and home-based respite
sections.summary: AIC will try this with a few providers first, then expand, and will also pilot home-based respite for palliative care cancer caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: AIC will try this out with a few providers first, iron out any operational matters as they study it for a period of time and then look to expand this to more providers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We will also pilot a home-based respite service for caregivers of palliative care cancer patients.

sections.label: Community outreach teams pilot
sections.summary: AIC will pilot these community outreach teams with community providers such as Caregiver Alliance Limited by end of 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: AIC will pilot these community outreach teams with community providers, such as Caregiver Alliance Limited, by the end of 2019.

sections.label: Eldercare training for caregivers and FDWs
sections.summary: Eldercare training will be enhanced for family caregivers and new FDWs early in their employment in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On that note, we will enhance eldercare training for family caregivers and also new FDWs early on in their employment in Singapore.

sections.label: Supporting caregivers and seniors ageing
sections.summary: The passage states that supporting caregivers helps seniors age in place with dignity, and notes Singapore ranks second globally for healthy life expectancy at birth.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Together, we can support and empower caregivers and, in turn, help our seniors in Singapore to age in place with dignity, in an environment which they know well, and with people who care and love them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Healthy longevity presents opportunities for us to transform ageing into a positive force.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We are second in the world for healthy life expectancy at birth, after Japan and ahead of South Korea.

sections.label: Action Plan for Successful Ageing
sections.summary: In 2015, the Action Plan for Successful Ageing was set out, a $3 billion plan with over 70 initiatives across 12 areas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In 2015, we set out to do this with the Action Plan for Successful Ageing, a $3 billion plan with more than 70 initiatives across 12 areas to make Singapore a Nation for All Ages.

sections.label: Functional screening and home visits
sections.summary: About 45,000 seniors benefited from nationwide functional screening since January 2018, and SG Ambassadors made over one million home visits to about 450,000 seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: About 45,000 seniors have benefited from this nationwide functional screening programme since January 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Beginning with the Pioneers in 2014, our SG Ambassadors have made more than one million home visits and engaged about 450,000 seniors aged 65 and above.

sections.label: National Silver Academy courses
sections.summary: The National Silver Academy offers over 1,000 courses in areas such as art, wellness and life skills, attracting some 26,000 participants thus far.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Today, the National Silver Academy (NSA) offers over 1,000 courses for seniors to pursue their interests in a wide range of areas, such as art, wellness and life skills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: These courses have attracted some 26,000 participants thus far.

sections.label: Community Networks for Seniors expansion
sections.summary: The Community Networks for Seniors initiative has been expanded nationwide to 89 neighbourhoods and areas, bringing together stakeholders to coordinate care for seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Our Community Networks for Seniors (CNS) initiative, which I am pleased to report has been expanded nationwide now to 89 neighbourhoods and areas, brings together stakeholders on the ground, including Government agencies, care providers and community organisations, to close the last-mile delivery of active ageing programmes and care services, and provide timely and coordinated care for our seniors when needed.

sections.label: Suicide rates among older residents
sections.summary: Suicide rates among Singapore residents aged 60 and above fell from 22.4 per 100,000 residents in 2007 to 16.4 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The suicide rates amongst Singapore residents aged 60 and above fell from 22.4 per 100,000 residents in 2007 to 16.4 in 2017.

sections.label: Senior volunteers in community programmes
sections.summary: Four in five community befrienders and one in four SG Ambassadors are senior volunteers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In fact, four in five community befrienders and one in four of our SG Ambassadors are senior volunteers.

sections.label: Student participation in programmes
sections.summary: More than 20,000 students have participated in such programmes to date.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: More than 20,000 students have participated in such programmes to date.

sections.label: Nursing home funding increase
sections.summary: Funding for nursing homes was recently reviewed and increased in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In fact, we recently reviewed and increased funding for nursing homes in 2018.

sections.label: C2H sites and clients
sections.summary: C2H is offered at 15 sites across Singapore, including Dr Lily Neo's ward, serving more than 3,500 clients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: C2H is currently offered at 15 sites across Singapore, including in Dr Lily Neo's ward, serving more than 3,500 clients.

sections.label: Home Caregiving Grant replacing FDW Grant
sections.summary: The Home Caregiving Grant will replace the FDW Grant, increasing financial support for caregivers of individuals with permanent disability needing help with at least three ADLs, and can be used for broader support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)
sentences.text: The Home Caregiving Grant that MOH will introduce to replace the FDW Grant will provide much-needed support for caregivers of persons with special needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)
sentences.text: It will increase financial support for caregivers of individuals with permanent disability, who require assistance to perform at least three ADLs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)
sentences.text: In addition, the grant can also be used for a broader range of support rather than just for hiring FDWs.

sections.label: Special Needs Trust Company set up
sections.summary: The Special Needs Trust Company was set up in 2008 to provide trust management services for these families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)
sentences.text: To address this concern, the Special Needs Trust Company (SNTC) was set up in 2008 to provide trust management services for these families.

sections.label: Special Education school transition support
sections.summary: VWOs report parents feel overwhelmed choosing care services for children graduating at 18, so work with MOE aims to improve transition management.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)
sentences.text: We also heard from VWOs that run Special Education schools that parents feel overwhelmed with options when deciding which care service would best suit their child who is about to graduate at age 18.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)
sentences.text: So, now, we are working closely with MOE to improve the transition management process to help parents make an informed decision on the appropriate care service for their child.

sections.label: LPA process and fee waiver

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)

sections.label: Rising LPA registrations and HDB suggestion

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)

sections.label: Park fitness corners, shelters, toilets

sections.label: Smart-enabled homes in Punggol Northshore

sentences.text: To better facilitate smart systems, such as monitoring systems for elderly care, HDB is piloting smart-enabled homes in Punggol's Northshore district.

sections.label: Kampung Admiralty architecture award

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Indeed, Kampung Admiralty has been lauded as a model to be emulated, clinching the World Building of the Year award at the 2018 World Architecture Festival.

sections.label: Retirement housing private market controls
sections.summary: Developers and senior care operators have shown interest in retirement housing, and controls are being studied to ensure private market products cater to their intended demographic.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Developers and senior care operators have, indeed, shown interest in providing retirement housing concepts in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Taking the lessons from the Jalan Jurong Kechil development, one area that we are keenly studying is how best to ensure future retirement housing products in the private market properly cater to their intended demographic, by introducing appropriate controls.

sections.label: Proximity Housing Grant amounts
sections.summary: The Proximity Housing Grant gives up to $30,000 to those buying a resale flat to live with parents or children, and up to $20,000 to those buying to live near them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: And we also have the Proximity Housing Grant (PHG) which was only just enhanced last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Those who purchase a resale flat to live with their parents/children can enjoy a PHG of up to $30,000, while those buying a resale flat to live near their parents/children can enjoy a PHG of up to $20,000.

sections.label: Flats completed and under construction

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Almost 500 of such flats have been completed, and about another 200 are under construction.

sections.label: Employment rate of older residents
sections.summary: The employment rate of residents aged 55 to 64 rose from 57% in 2008 to 67% in 2018, an increase of 10 percentage points.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The employment rate of residents aged 55 to 64 rose from 57% in 2008 to 67% in 2018, an increase of 10 percentage points.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: For example, employers hiring older workers receive wage offsets of up to 11% of their monthly wages via the Special Employment Credit (SEC), as well as training and salary support for employing mature PMETs.

sections.label: Smarte Carte older worker workforce

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Smarte Carte, which supports Changi Airport's operations, is one such company.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: I am impressed that over half of their 300-strong workforce is made up of older workers.

sections.label: Support for older workers

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: To better support older workers at work, Mr Patrick Tay and Mr Ang Wei Neng have asked for the Special Employment Credit and WorkPro schemes to be enhanced and extended.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: I want to assure them that MOM is currently reviewing the schemes and will certainly share more details when the information is ready.

sections.label: Flexible work arrangements uptake

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The proportion of companies in Singapore offering at least one ad hoc FWA has increased from 68% in 2013 to 84% in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Those offering at least one formal FWA also rose from 44% in 2013 to 53% in 2018.

sections.label: Companies offering formal FWAs

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Last year, about 23% of the companies here offer at least two formal FWAs and that is up from 12% in 2013.

sections.label: Unplanned time-off offerings
sections.summary: Eighty-one percent of companies currently offer unplanned time-off, an increase from 67% five years ago.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Eighty-one percent of the companies in Singapore currently offer unplanned time-off, and this is a marked increase from 67% five years ago.

sections.label: Work-Life Grant extension
sections.summary: MOM extended and enhanced the Work-Life Grant, letting each company receive up to $105,000 over two years for employees' FWAs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: MOM recently extended and enhanced the Work-Life Grant for companies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: This scheme allows each company to receive up to $105,000 over two years to help the company maintain their employees' FWAs on a regular basis, whether it is flexi-time, flexi-load and flexi-place.

sections.label: Work-Life Grant applications

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Since its launch, the Work-Life Grant has received more than 340 applications in five months.

sentences.text: As at December 2018, about 1,200 employers hiring 380,000 workers have adopted the Tripartite Standard on FWAs, while some 430 employers hiring 220,000 workers have adopted the Tripartite Standard on Unpaid Leave for Unexpected Care Needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: In 2018, over 153,000 elderly persons received Silver Support payouts amounting to $335 million.

sections.label: CPF transfers from family members

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Last year, a total of 3,200 members benefited from CPF transfers from their spouses, while a total of about 2,800 members received CPF transfers from their children and grandchildren.

sections.label: Basic Retirement Sum attainment by 2020
sections.summary: About 70% of active members are expected to attain the Basic Retirement Sum at age 55 by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Attainment of the Basic Retirement Sum (BRS) has been improving steadily, with about 70% of active members being expected to attain BRS at the age of 55 by 2020.

sections.label: CPF Retirement Planning Service expansion
sections.summary: In 2015 a one-on-one CPF Retirement Planning Service was introduced, and last year it was expanded to include options such as the Silver Housing Bonus.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: In 2015, we introduced a one-on-one personalised CPF Retirement Planning Service (CRPS) to help older workers better understand the various CPF schemes and make their plans before they turn 55.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Last year, we expanded CRPS to include options, such as the Silver Housing Bonus, which lets the members unlock the value of their HDB flats and boost their retirement payouts.

sections.label: Age-smart companies and senior mentoring
sections.summary: Age-smart companies creating mentoring opportunities for senior workers can enjoy age diversity, improve productivity, attract and retain talent, and encourage continuous upskilling.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: And by creating opportunities for our senior workers to mentor the younger workers, these "age-smart" companies can enjoy the best of "both worlds" and also enjoy health age diversity which, according to many research articles, will also improve productivity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: This not only helps them to attract and retain talent, it also encourages the employees to adopt the mindset of continuous upskilling to remain employable and to remain productive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: So, together, we can age purposefully in a caring society where work and family have a place, and where our responsibilities and aspirations are met as we strive to support one another.

sections.label: Volunteerism rate among seniors

sentences.text: According to the National Volunteer and Philanthropy Centre's (NVPC's) Individual Giving Surveys, the volunteerism rate among those 50 and older has been growing steadily over the years, from 13% in 2008, to 29% in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: One such organisation is the Organisation of Senior Volunteers (RSVP) Singapore, which has been actively training and matching over 2,500 Silver volunteers for the past 20 years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: To date, two Labs have been opened at Our Tampines Hub and Heartbeat@Bedok, with another four more scheduled to be opened in Bishan, Jurong East, Sengkang and Woodlands by end-March 2019.

sections.label: NAC Silver Arts Festival
sections.summary: NAC has held an annual Silver Arts Festival since 2012 to showcase seniors' creativity and promote intergenerational bonding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: For instance, NAC has organised an annual Silver Arts Festival since 2012 to showcase the creativity of our seniors and promote intergenerational bonding.

sections.summary: Seniors and their families, friends and caregivers can engage through a Conversation Starter Kit co-developed by NHB and other organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann)

sentences.text: MCCY has been working alongside a number of organisations that help match seniors to volunteering activities according to their interests, availability and preferred locations.

sections.label: Elder-friendly sports facilities

sentences.text: MCCY and Singapore Sports Council have been working together to build more elder-friendly sports facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: In particular, gymnasiums managed by the Council will progressively install exercise equipment suitable for seniors to help them stay active and fit.

sections.label: Merdeka Generation Package and motions
sections.summary: The speaker notes the Merdeka Generation Package is used regularly and that Merdeka means freedom and independence, then calls on Mr Henry Kwek and Dr Chia Shi-Lu to reply on their motions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: They are all incredibly important because without good policies and effective implementation, nothing happens, but to what end?

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: This is where I note that we use the "Merdeka Generation Package" quite regularly and I know that some of you Members are part of the Merdeka Generation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: But I think it is instructive to remember that Merdeka means "freedom" and "independence".

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: That is an aspiration that we are all inspiring towards, in the way we realise our older years as a nation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: With that, I will now call on Mr Henry Kwek to make his reply on his Motion on Ageing with Purpose, followed by Dr Chia Shi-Lu for his reply on the Motion on Support for Caregivers.

sections.label: Suggestions on jobs for seniors
sections.summary: Ms Rahayu Mahzam and the speaker suggested a sector-based, tripartite approach for jobs and freelance access, while Mr Patrick Tay suggested extending the Career Support Programme and topping up SkillsFuture Credit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Ms Rahayu Mahzam and I suggested adopting a sector-based, tripartite approach to create more full and part-time jobs and to help seniors better access freelance opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Mr Patrick Tay suggested extending the Career Support Programme, especially since PMETs' unemployment and underemployment are a concern.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: He also suggested a top-up of the SkillsFuture Credit.

sections.label: CPF RA flexibility for housing
sections.summary: Miss Cheryl Chan spoke about more flexibility for seniors to tap CPF Retirement Accounts for housing so they do not become cash-poor after selling their lease back.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Miss Cheryl Chan spoke about more flexibility for seniors to tap on CPF RAs for housing so that they do not become cash-poor after selling their lease back to the Government.

sections.label: Raising CPF for older workers
sections.summary: Mr Ang Wei Neng, Dr Intan Mokhtar and the speaker spoke about gradually raising CPF for older workers to levels similar to younger workers when economic conditions allow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Mr Ang Wei Neng, Dr Intan Mokhtar and myself spoke about gradually raising CPF for older workers to levels similar to those of younger workers, when the economic conditions allow for it.

sections.label: Extension of support schemes
sections.summary: Mr Ang Wei Neng, Mr Patrick Tay and the speaker collectively asked for an extension of the Special Employment Credit, Silver Support Scheme and WIS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Collectively, Mr Ang Wei Neng, Mr Patrick Tay and myself asked for an extension of the Special Employment Credit, Silver Support Scheme and WIS.

sections.label: VWOs and grassroots food aid
sections.summary: Speaker Tan partners VWOs to serve food to nearly 450 needy families, and Dr Lily Neo's grassroots created a social enterprise for affordable AL services to over 500 residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Speaker Tan also partners VWOs to serve food to the nearly 450 needy families, 24/7, 365 days a year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Dr Lily Neo shared on how her grassroots rolled up their sleeves to create a social enterprise to provide affordable AL services to more than 500 of her residents.

sections.label: Merdeka Generation Package review
sections.summary: Rolling out the Merdeka Generation Package is an opportunity to review senior-related policies and empower seniors to pursue independent, active lives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Indeed, to roll out the Merdeka Generation Package is a good opportunity for us to review our country's senior-related policies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: The Merdeka Generation laid the foundations of the independent and modern Singapore with their can-do spirit and resilience.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Now is a good time for Singapore to empower our Merdeka Generation and all our seniors to pursue an independent and active life in their golden years, filled with purpose and dignity.

sections.label: PAP.SG on ageing policies
sections.summary: PAP.SG believes the Government can enact appropriate policies to address long-term ageing issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: PAP.SG believes that the Government can enact appropriate policies to address long-term ageing issues.

sections.label: Best place to age in place
sections.summary: We must endeavour to be the best place in the world to age in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Ultimately, we must endeavour to be the best place in the world to age in place.

sections.label: Caregiver Allowance and MediSave
sections.summary: Several Members agreed the Government should look into a Caregiver Allowance, and MOH will extend MediSave use to siblings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Many Members – Dr Lily Neo, Mr Chen Show Mao, Mr Christopher de Souza, Ms Tin Pei Ling, Mr Murali Pillai and also Dr Intan Mokhtar – agreed with me that the Government should look into providing a Caregiver Allowance of some form, in line with countries like Sweden, the UK, Australia and Hong Kong.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: I am also particularly happy that MOH will be allowing MediSave use to be extended to siblings, as this is not an uncommon appeal that I receive both as a doctor from my patients and also as a Member of Parliament from my residents.

sections.label: Workplace and workforce support
sections.summary: Several Members called for workplace and workforce support, and MOM will focus on flexible working hours and the Work-Life Grant.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Mr Melvin Yong, Ms Joan Pereira, Ms Rahayu and myself have called for various means of workplace and workforce support.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: I am encouraged that MOM will be focusing on measures to facilitate flexible working hours and considering enhancements to the Work-Life Grant.

sections.label: Respite care for caregivers
sections.summary: Speakers say respite care must be more accessible and affordable, and welcome dementia night respite and pre-enrolment announcements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Respite care is a critical component of caring for caregivers and more has to be done to make respite care in Singapore more accessible and more affordable, as noted by Ms Tin Pei Ling, Dr Lily Neo, Er Dr Lee Bee Wah and Mr Christopher de Souza.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: I welcome the announcements on the night respite care service for seniors with dementia and steps, such as pre-enrolment, to reduce onboarding times for respite services.

sections.label: Motion on support for caregivers
sections.summary: The Motion recognises caregivers' role in caring for seniors and calls on Government and Singaporeans to support them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: It is a duty that is often not anticipated and often unprepared for, but there is no nobler duty, particularly when we are caring for the elderly who cared for us when we were little and similarly vulnerable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: This Motion was raised to recognise this crucial role that caregivers play in society, particularly in regard to looking after our seniors, and we call upon the Government and all Singaporeans to continue our steadfast support for the caregivers amongst us.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I shall put the necessary questions to the House for a decision.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: We will first deal with Mr Henry Kwek's Motion on Ageing with Purpose.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: We now deal with Dr Chia Shi-Lu's Motion on Support for Caregivers.
